objective: Convert existing market demand into legitimate revenue as directly as possible, prioritizing end-to-end autonomous execution and reusable one-time setup rails.

priority: Fully executable now with existing tools
One-time setup unlocks reusable high-value rail
Reject when recurring unsupported manual work remains
execution_policy.target_payment_window: same-day preferred; otherwise credible first payment within 7 days

candidates.name: Clawlancer
candidates.rail: Clawlancer MCP/REST -> prefunded Base-USDC bounties -> API claim/deliver -> escrow -> USDC wallet
candidates.one_time_setup: Register an agent, retain its API key/wallet identity, and expose the Clawlancer MCP or REST credential to an environment ChatGPT can operate. Fund approximately $0.10 of ETH on Base only if welcome gas is unavailable.
candidates.what_it_unlocks: Programmatic discovery, bounty claim, delivery submission, transaction evidence/disputes, notifications, balance checks, and USDC withdrawal.
candidates.current_inventory_observation: Fresh marketplace inventory is dominated by $0.01-$0.03 starter/demo bounties; a $5 same-day API viability report and an indexed $95 QA evidence bounty were found, but the $95 listing's current claimability could not be independently confirmed from the rendered detail page.
candidates.india_eligibility: No India exclusion found in the published terms; payouts are cryptocurrency and user remains responsible for applicable law/tax compliance.
candidates.execution_chain_after_setup: 9/10 to 10/10 depending on whether a live bounty requires external artifacts beyond text/API delivery.
candidates.expected_value: Rail quality is high; immediate expected value is moderate-to-low until more non-starter funded bounties appear. Better infrastructure than most human freelance marketplaces, but not yet sufficient to justify setup solely for today's visible cents-level inventory.

candidates.name: Frantic agent marketplace
candidates.rail: Frantic MCP -> paid agent bounties -> x402 payout
candidates.one_time_setup: Connect the Frantic MCP endpoint to an environment ChatGPT can operate and complete reusable identity/payout onboarding.

candidates.name: Agrenting autonomous-agent marketplace
candidates.rail: Agrenting provider agent -> MCP/REST -> escrowed tasks -> stablecoin payout
candidates.one_time_setup: Connect provider/MCP rail and configure reusable payout wallet/identity.

candidates.name: SporeAgent
candidates.observations: Docs support register/browse/bid/deliver through MCP and Stripe escrow with 15% platform fee, but task pages show roughly 159-182 day-old open inventory and public home/dashboard payout totals conflict ($48,210 vs $300). Do not spend setup effort until fresh paid task activity is verified.

candidates.name: GPUsion contributor bounties
candidates.reason: External GitHub PR work still requires recurring unsupported fork provisioning under the current connector.

search_filters_learned: Canonical issue/task must be open and current.
Verify funding or payer evidence at canonical source, not a mirror.
Read comments/bids before build; reject maintainer-confirmed competing worker unless economics justify race.
Reject already-rewarded issues even if state remains open.
Prefer narrow acceptance criteria over full-stack multi-client bounties.
Do not start substantial coding until write/submission path is verified.
External GitHub PR bounties fail autonomy when each upstream requires a manual fork.
Do not treat historical marketplace payout activity as current demand; require fresh open inventory.
For agent-native marketplaces, separate rail quality from inventory quality: a perfect API is not worth setup when nearly all currently claimable work is pennies.
Treat conflicting public marketplace metrics as a reliability warning requiring independent verification before setup.

latest_scan.material_learning: Clawlancer exposes one of the strongest end-to-end agent APIs found so far, including registration, prefunded bounty claim, delivery, escrow/dispute, notifications and USDC withdrawal. However fresh visible inventory is dominated by $0.01-$0.03 tasks, so infrastructure quality alone does not justify immediate setup without stronger live bounty value.

next_action.instruction: Watch Clawlancer for fresh bounties above a meaningful minimum (prefer >=$10), while continuing discovery of agent-native MCP/API rails with verified current funded demand. If a sufficiently valuable Clawlancer bounty appears, setup becomes immediately justified because post-setup execution is API-native.
